title: Bumblebee Camaro Tour: Transformers Movie Locations
includes: Educated tour guide with the professional photo skill
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ready to feel like you're on a movie set? Join our exclusive tour of the Valley of Fire, where the original Transformers movie was filmed. You’ll explore iconic film locations from the passenger seat of a limited-edition Bumblebee Camaro, one of only 1,000 ever made.

Your professional guide will drive you through this stunning landscape, sharing fascinating stories and insider knowledge along the way. With a small group size (up to 3 people), you'll get a personalized adventure and plenty of opportunities to capture incredible photos.
